items.html: Let us explain the order of the emanation of the seven kings. We shall begin with the first, which is the Daat, which emerged first. When the vessel could not endure, the vessel broke and descended in the world of Beria, meaning in the place that was to be the world of Beria afterwards, since the world of Beria has not been created yet. Also, this vessel fell in the place of Daat of Beria, as it relates to it like it. However, the light of Daat descended, too, but remained in Atzilut itself, in the place of the vessel of Malchut of Atzilut.
